assumptions.description_zh: 场地边界基于任务书描述和公开地图推导，标注为provisional_constraint。官方边界数据尚未获取，所有空间分析为临时结果。
assumptions.description_en: Site boundary derived from taskbook description and public maps, marked as provisional_constraint. Official boundary data not yet obtained; all spatial analysis is provisional.
assumptions.impact_zh: 面积计算、土地利用分区、指标计算均基于临时几何，需在官方数据可用后重新计算
assumptions.mitigation_zh: 所有GeoJSON标注official_boundary=false；所有指标标注status=estimated；proposal.md中明确声明限制
